trust_decision.summary: Space-member-authored Automation params (param_1/param_2, and TRANSPOSE param_1/param_2 interpolated unescaped) are compiled and run as regexes by AutomationEngine with stdlib re and no time bound; the fix swaps to the `regex` package with timeout=0.05 at every re.match/re.sub call in that engine. No validation exists at write time in AutomationSerializer.

landing_point.why: apply_regex_replace_automation is the only function whose docstring says params are regex patterns; the summary says 'automation regex patterns'.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/ingredient-from-string/ and IngredientParserView.post (cookbook/views/api.py:3262, 3288) -> IngredientParser.parse -> apply_transpose_automation (cookbook/helper/ingredient_parser.py:209); also URL import and all file-import integrations
same as above, uncached branch (IngredientParser(request, False) at cookbook/views/api.py:3288)

recipe URL import get_from_scraper (cookbook/views/api.py:2675, 2828 -> cookbook/helper/recipe_url_import.py:55,70,210), YouTube import (cookbook/helper/recipe_url_import.py:274,277), food/unit via IngredientParser.get_food/get_unit (cookbook/helper/ingredient_parser.py:37,55)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published sites are in one file, cookbook/helper/automation_helper.py; the cached vs uncached branches are duplicate loops in the same function, not a separate implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 import routes: they interpolate data from an uploaded archive (recipe name / image field) into a pattern rather than a stored Automation rule, so a solver can call it 'file-import filename matching, not automation regex'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate user regex rules must keep working: source-URL match with '.*allrecipes.*', anchored '^remove_' and plain substring replacement with backrefs/blank replacement; TRANSPOSE needs \b group swap. A fix that re.escape()s params or rejects regex metachars breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: REPLACE rule source pattern (param_1, matched against source URL)
REPLACE rule target pattern (param_2, run over field text)
TRANSPOSE_WORDS param_1/param_2 interpolated into an f-string pattern
cached (dict) and uncached (DB queryset) rule-loading branches

O7_producer.where: cookbook/helper/automation_helper.py:202-214 and 156-168 (rules loaded into caches['default'] and replayed)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Nextcloud Cookbook zip import interpolates the uploaded recipe name unescaped into re.match against every zip entry name, with no timeout.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Pattern comes from an imported file rather than an Automation rule; it's a different sink (image lookup in the import code), so a solver can treat it as outside the automation advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (cookbook/integration vs cookbook/helper), 2 files away

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Chowdown zip import interpolates the uploaded 'image:' front-matter value unescaped into re.match over zip entry names, with no timeout.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above: an import-format filename match, not automation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A regex variant of keyword alias matching (KEYWORD_ALIAS rules applied with re.fullmatch) reached via parse_keywords at cookbook/helper/recipe_url_import.py:443.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Alias helpers sit beside the regex helpers and use the same param_1/param_2 rule shape; a maintainer could plausibly add 'regex alias' support.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: NEVER_UNIT matching done via a param_1 regex instead of a dict lookup.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same rule table and same engine; the transpose rule already interpolates params into a pattern.

O9_family: CWE-1333 ReDoS / regex injection from user-stored patterns

O10_build.toolchain: Django 5.2 (requirements.txt:1), pytest; fix needs the new `regex` dependency, which is not in requirements.txt at the pinned commit
O10_build.project_tests: cookbook/tests/other/test_automations.py (regex replace, transpose, never-unit); the fix diff adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap only apply_regex_replace_automation's param_2 re.sub in a timeout (or re.escape the params), missing the source-URL match, the TRANSPOSE f-string pattern and the second loading branch.

out_of_scope_notes: AutomationEngine.regex_replace is a class-level mutable dict shared across instances (cookbook/helper/automation_helper.py:18-24); the cache key at line 204 is per-space, but the class attribute is not. Not pursued.

Built-in parser regexes over ingredient text (cookbook/helper/ingredient_parser.py:187,193) use fixed patterns with nested quantifiers on input of up to 512 chars; these are fixed patterns, not user-controlled ones. Not pursued.
unverified: Whether recipe.name length is capped before nextcloud_cookbook.py:101 (would bound but not remove the pattern-injection risk).
Present-in-latest for O8 routes is unknown (no latest release provided).
Family is resource exhaustion, which lessons-v2 lists as 0 of 7 hard tasks; the O8 routes are where-type and their sink differs from the advisory's, so they are weak levers.
